candidate_relations.reason: Nevus lipomatosus superficialis may resemble the fibrofatty lesion clinically and histologically but does not preserve the required etiology as residua of an involuted infantile hemangioma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Distinct congenital adipose hamartoma rather than post-involution hemangioma residuum.

candidate_relations.reason: Fibrolipoma describes mature adipose and fibrous tissue as a primary tumor but omits and conflicts with the required origin from an involuted infantile hemangioma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Distinct benign fibroadipose neoplasm rather than post-involution hemangioma residuum.
